newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares end higher on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end higher on selective buying.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices rallied on Thursday after Wednesday's minor correction with institutions seen selectively buying shares of firms expected to post good 1996 results, brokers said.
The B share index rose 1.76 points or 1.16 percent to end at 154.46 on turnover of HK$119.13 million, compared with HK$113.98 million in the previous session.
The A share index rebounded 2.35 points or 0.63 percent to 372.35 on turnover of 6.64 billion yuan against Wednesday's 5.2 billion yuan.
"I expect the indices to move in a tight range on Friday, the last session (before the two-week Chinese lunar new year holiday)," a broker said.
Institutional buying in counters surrounded by talks of good earnings boosted the indices but the holiday mood dampened follow-up buying, brokers said.

On the B share market, Lizhu Pharmaceutical was the best performer and rose HK$0.34 or 6.67 percent to HK$5.44 on volume of 898,313 shares, pushed up by optimism over the firm's outlook, brokers said.
Building materials producer Fangda firmed HK$0.47 or 5.33 percent to HK$9.29 on trade of 1.17 million shares. Changan Automobile gained HK$0.18 to HK$4.73 after 1.38 million shares were traded.
Hainan Pearl River, dragged by profit-taking, shaved HK$0.06 to HK$3.90 on the day's heaviest volume of 2.94 million shares, brokers said.
Guangdong Power followed on volume of 2.63 million shares and charged ahead HK$0.08 to HK$7.08 amid talk that it would report a strong rise in last year's net profits, they said.

On the A share market, fertilizer maker Shenzhen Liaohe Tongda Chemical Industry Co Ltd, which listed 117 million A shares on Thursday, ended the session at 11.20 yuan compared with an offer price of 5.38 yuan earlier this month. Volume was 88.94 million shares.
Hainan-based counters were among the day's stars, fuelled by speculation over their 1996 results, brokers said.
Property developer Hainan New Energy soared 0.64 yuan or 8.88 percent to 7.85 yuan as 8.64 million shares changed hands. Hainan Nanyang Shipping surged 0.51 yuan to 6.40 yuan on 14.8 million shares.
